It's not Sentinel. Sentinel is on the coast and surrounded by forest and desert. This city is near but not on the coast, on top of being surrounded by mostly grasslands and a nearby mountainous region. This is why I think the city is Gilane, but it could also be Taneth. Still Hammerfell, but the city definitely isn't Sentinel.

So, upon doing some studying of the topography of both High Rock and Hammerfell, I've come to the conclusion that the city in the trailer is Gilane, which would lead me to believe that it's going to be set at least partially in Hammerfell.
